pages.title: Dashboard
pages.summary: Your home screen. Employees see assignments, PTO, and operational snapshots. Clients see their customer portal overview only.
howTo: Open Dashboard from the left sidebar.
Review summary cards and any alerts at the top of the page.

pages.title: Clients
pages.summary: Manage agency client accounts, contacts, status, and outstanding balances.
howTo: Go to Clients in the left sidebar.
Scroll to the New Client form (or use Create client).
Fill out client name, industry, and contact details.
Click Create client to save.

pages.title: Contracts
pages.summary: Create and manage commercial agreements: retainers, project fees, campaign budgets, and billing methods.
howTo: Go to Contracts in the left sidebar.
Use the New contract form at the bottom of the page.
Select a client, enter contract name/number, dates, and billing method.
Click Create contract to save.

pages.title: Campaigns
pages.summary: Track marketing campaigns tied to clients and contracts, including budget health and delivery status.
howTo: Go to Campaigns in the left sidebar.
Use Create campaign to add a campaign linked to a client and contract.
Monitor status and budget on the campaigns list or detail page.

pages.title: Work
pages.summary: Log billable and non-billable hours against campaigns (project progress and delivery tracking).
howTo: Go to Work in the left sidebar.
Fill in campaign, date, work type, hours, and description.
Click Log work to save the entry.

pages.title: Costs
pages.summary: Record advertising spend, vendor costs, and pass-through expenses against campaigns or contracts.
howTo: Go to Costs in the left sidebar.
Choose cost type (for example Advertising Spend or Pass-Through).
Enter amount, date, vendor, and whether it is pass-through.
Click Record cost to save.

pages.title: Approvals
pages.summary: Client sign-off on creative, budget, and launch decisions before work proceeds or is billed.
howTo: Go to Approvals in the left sidebar.
Review pending requests and update approval status with notes as needed.

pages.title: Billing
pages.summary: Generate invoices from contracts, campaigns, and unbilled work. Track invoice status and revenue recognition.
howTo: Go to Billing in the left sidebar.
Use the Create invoice form.
Select client (and contract/campaign when applicable), amounts, and dates.
Click Create invoice to save.

pages.title: Accounts Receivable
pages.summary: Monitor unpaid invoices, aging, collections, and record customer payments.
howTo: Go to Accounts Receivable in the left sidebar.
Review outstanding and overdue invoices.
Use Record payment to log a payment against an invoice.

pages.title: Reports
pages.summary: Dashboards for profitability, campaign budget performance, billing, and operational metrics.
howTo: Go to Reports in the left sidebar.
Review profitability, budget, and billing charts and tables.

terms.definition: A recurring monthly fee paid by a client for ongoing marketing services. In Contracts, set Billing method to Monthly Retainer and enter Monthly retainer.
A fixed price for a scoped project (for example a brand refresh). Tracked on contracts and campaigns as Project fee.
The planned spend envelope for a marketing campaign, used to compare against recorded costs.
An expense billed to the client at cost (or marked up per contract), such as media buy or production. Flag Pass-through when recording a cost.
Paid media costs (ads, boosts, placements). Record under Costs with cost type Advertising Spend.
Hours logged on Work that can be included on an invoice. Mark entries billable when logging work.
A formal request for payment created in Billing. Statuses include Draft, Sent, Partially Paid, Paid, Overdue, and more.
Money clients owe the agency. Use Accounts Receivable to see unpaid invoices and record payments.
Revenue versus costs for clients, contracts, or campaigns. Review live profitability on Reports and client detail context.
An active client relationship covered by one or more contracts and campaigns.
Statement of Work — often captured as a contract record describing scope, fees, and dates.
Client or internal sign-off before creative launches or billing. Tracked in Approvals.

workflows.title: Add a new client
steps: Open Clients from the left sidebar.
Fill out the New Client form (name, industry, contact).
Click Create client.

workflows.title: Create a contract
steps: Open Contracts from the left sidebar.
In New contract, select the client and enter contract details.
Choose billing method (Monthly Retainer, Project Fee, Campaign Billing, Pass-Through, or Mixed).
Click Create contract.

workflows.title: Generate an invoice
steps: Open Billing from the left sidebar.
Use Create invoice and select the client.
Attach contract/campaign context and amounts as needed.
Click Create invoice.

workflows.title: View unpaid invoices
steps: Open Accounts Receivable from the left sidebar.
Review invoices that are Sent, Partially Paid, or Overdue.
Use Record payment when a client pays.

workflows.title: Log project hours
steps: Open Work from the left sidebar.
Select the campaign and enter date, work type, and hours.
Click Log work.

workflows.title: Record advertising expenses
steps: Open Costs from the left sidebar.
Set cost type to Advertising Spend (or Pass-Through if billed through).
Enter amount, vendor, and campaign/contract.
Click Record cost.

workflows.title: Track profitability
steps: Open Reports from the left sidebar.
Review profitability charts and tables for clients and campaigns.
Compare revenue (invoices/payments) against costs and labor.

workflows.title: View campaign reports
steps: Open Reports from the left sidebar for performance and budget views.
Or open Campaigns to inspect an individual campaign’s budget health.
